notes: Atomic dock positioning, full 11-icon Windows 11 system tray, Bluetooth inquiry scan, and auto-updater.

releases.title: Dock Stability, Full Tray, Bluetooth Scan & Auto-Update
changes: Locked main dock HWND coordinates via WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGING and atomic SetWindowPos to stop upward jumps when opening or closing apps.
Restored full 11+ Windows 11 system tray icon enumeration (UWP/Packaged + Win32) and double-click toggle close.
Added live Bluetooth classic + BLE inquiry scanning (discoverable/connectable devices).
Fixed Storage header live stats on immediate open and added built-in GitHub auto-updater + Changelog tab.

releases.title: Stripe Checkout, Custom MSI Installer & App Icon
changes: Updated lifetime license Stripe checkout integration and branded metallic N application icon.
Enabled NSIS and MSI installers with clean uninstallation and taskbar-guard watchdog protection.
Stabilized parallel COM/STA audio and Wi-Fi test suites.

releases.title: Liquid Glass Engine & Smart Taskbar Integration
changes: Added native Liquid Glass refraction backdrop sampling and smooth magnification spring presets.
Added Focus timer, Screen Time tracking, Weather, Stocks, Calendar, and AI Integrations popovers.
